jobs.name: Native Job Object ABI on minimum Bun

minimumBunAbi.scope: Actual kernel32 Job Object creation, limits, accounting, integer handles and disposal. This is not a full framework suite on minimum Bun.

runtime: Bun 1.4.2 on native Windows for timeout, process ownership, complete output, cancellation and application preload regressions.
invariants: The 300 ms timed consumer check and immediate directory disposal assertions are unchanged.
Windows cleanup confirms native zero-active-member accounting and direct process handle completion.
All Windows owner cleanup phases retain a 1000 ms confirmation grace.
Application preload hooks run in the checked command; the internal owner uses a private minimal Bun configuration.
The owner requires no PowerShell, external C# compiler or PID-tree cleanup helper.
limits: This is native Windows process and configuration ownership evidence. It does not establish native game rendering or original Gold Edition parity.
Publication and downstream installation require separate successful source, release, original artifact and installed-consumer gates.
